steps.what: Create a donor row from the gift just received
Review the donor row before it is stored
Update donor databases with the accepted row

tasks.design: The fundraiser creates or updates donor databases. The fundraiser still decides which person the gift belongs to, at full effort. {CRM} stores only the row the fundraiser has accepted. A blank name stays blank and is not matched by guess. Nobody is scored.
tasks.previous_blocker: The fundraiser typed each donor row.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted row can be stored. Matching the person stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding that two gifts are the same donor stays with the fundraiser.
tasks.human_edge: The fundraiser does not store a guessed name.
tasks.altitude: The database changes only after the fundraiser accepts that row.

reach.task: See only a donor row the fundraiser accepted

evidence.claim: An accepted donor row can be stored. Deciding who the donor is stays manual. Donors are not scored.

assumptions: The work starts with a gift and ends when the accepted row is stored, or the fundraiser stops.
A donor row has name, gift identifier, and date, written by the fundraiser. A blank name is left blank and is not matched to another person.
The store uses the row accepted in the review. It does not merge records by itself.
unknowns: Which gifts arrive without a name the fundraiser can confirm.
research_questions: How often did a blank name stop the store?

already_counted.description: Creating the donor row is already in the fundraiser's step.

incremental.description: Correct a name before the row is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: names are often blank, so the fundraiser still creates the row. High: names are complete, the fundraiser reviews the row, and only the accepted row is stored. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop strategies to encourage new or increased contributions
Reject a strategy the contribution history does not support

tasks.design: The fundraiser develops strategies to encourage new or increased contributions. The strategy stays at full effort. {BI} does not choose the strategy. Donors are not scored.
tasks.previous_blocker: The fundraiser set the strategy from the history they know.
tasks.still_hard: What will encourage a contribution stays with the fundraiser.
tasks.human_edge: The fundraiser rejects a strategy the history does not support.
tasks.altitude: The strategy stays at full effort.

reach.task: Hear the strategy from the fundraiser

evidence.claim: Developing a contribution strategy stays a judgement.

assumptions: The brief is the donor, event, or cause the fundraiser already holds. A blank name is left blank.
No score is stored for a donor, a volunteer, or a member of staff. Upkeep is zero.
An ask for a gift is a different conversation from filing a record.
unknowns: Which of these conversations the fundraiser will not delegate.
research_questions: How often did the fundraiser stop rather than ask?

already_counted.description: This conversation is already in the fundraiser's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the conversation adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every strategy is still developed by the fundraiser. High: the same judgement remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop fundraising activities such as annual giving campaigns
Implement direct mail programs the fundraiser has chosen

tasks.design: The fundraiser develops or implements fundraising activities, such as annual giving campaigns or direct mail programs. Choosing and running the activity stays at full effort. {EMAIL} does not launch a program.
tasks.previous_blocker: The fundraiser designed the campaign and ran it.
tasks.still_hard: Which activity to run stays with the fundraiser.
tasks.human_edge: The fundraiser does not start a program the cause has not agreed.
tasks.altitude: The activity stays at full effort.

reach.task: Agree the campaign the fundraiser proposes

evidence.claim: Developing or implementing a fundraising activity stays manual.

assumptions: The brief is the donor, event, or cause the fundraiser already holds. A blank name is left blank.
No score is stored for a donor, a volunteer, or a member of staff. Upkeep is zero.
An ask for a gift is a different conversation from filing a record.
unknowns: Which of these conversations the fundraiser will not delegate.
research_questions: How often did the fundraiser stop rather than ask?

already_counted.description: This conversation is already in the fundraiser's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the conversation adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every activity is still developed by the fundraiser. High: the same campaign work remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Compile stored facts for granting or other funding organizations
Develop the materials the fundraiser will submit
Review the grant materials before submission
Submit the accepted materials to the funding body

tasks.design: The fundraiser compiles or develops materials to submit to granting or other funding organizations. {DOCS} lists only stored facts. A blank required fact stays blank and stops the draft. The fundraiser still develops the materials, at full effort. {EMAIL} submits only the version the fundraiser has accepted.
tasks.previous_blocker: The fundraiser compiled the pack and submitted it.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored facts can be listed. The narrative stays the fundraiser's.
tasks.still_hard: What the application claims stays with the fundraiser.
tasks.human_edge: The fundraiser does not submit a blank fact as if it were known.
tasks.altitude: The materials are submitted only after the fundraiser accepts that version.

reach.task: Receive only materials the fundraiser accepted

evidence.claim: Stored facts can be listed into a pack. Developing and submitting the materials stays with the fundraiser after they accept the version.

assumptions: The work starts with a funding request and ends when the accepted materials are submitted, or the fundraiser stops.
A fact row has field name and value, entered by the fundraiser from the organisation's own records. A blank value is left blank and is not invented.
The submit uses the materials accepted in the review. It does not answer a question the fundraiser left blank.
research_questions: How often did a blank fact stop the draft?

already_counted.description: Developing the materials is already in the fundraiser's step.

incremental.description: Correct a fact before the materials are accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: facts are often blank, so the fundraiser still develops the pack. High: facts are complete, the fundraiser reviews the pack, and only the accepted materials are submitted. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The fundraiser still asks, bargains, and chooses the donor. A thank-you, a grant file, or a report is sent or stored only after the fundraiser accepts that version.
reach: A donor receives only a thank-you the fundraiser has accepted.
A funding organisation receives only materials the fundraiser has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a gift, amount, or name is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a send.
Keep the ask, the commitment, and the strategy in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every thank-you traces to a stored gift, and the fundraiser still writes the sentence.
